classical_note: Separately measured with current synthetic-tourism-v1 joblibs: LR and SVM predicted neutral (not positivo) on FAILURE_SHORT. The user-reported triple-positivo outcome may correspond to a longer surface form or a different model binding.
findings: Short failure case (~122 BETO tokens) fits in 128 and predicted negativo with the recovered V3 artifact.
Long praise-prefixed failure (~206 tokens) loses transporte/reclamación at max_length=128 and predicted positivo.
The same long text predicted negativo at max_length=256 because the failure clause remained.
Truncation is a demonstrated risk for praise-then-failure narratives longer than 128 tokens; it is not the sole explanation for every short mixed review.
